title: Reconcile challenge board
description: Use pnpm tsecbench list/status to snapshot the board; write evidence/tsec/board.json (or .txt) with unique_code, difficulty, container_status, and scores.

title: Start one challenge and recon entry
description: Prefer an incomplete medium challenge (e.g. e1-01). pnpm tsecbench start <code>, wait until container_status=available, then HTTP recon the container_addr (VPN required). Save banner/headers under evidence/tsec/recon-*.txt. Never start more than 3 concurrent containers.

title: Exploit and submit flag
description: Authorized TSecBench only. Find flag on the started challenge, submit via pnpm tsecbench submit <code> <flag>, save the API JSON under evidence/tsec/submit-*.json. Then pnpm tsecbench close <code>. Avoid hint unless stuck (hint costs score).

title: Write findings note
description: Short findings note under evidence/goals/ for the challenge attempted.
